items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh injury.
items.implication: Jets RB committee shift; start handcuffs if available.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers is active and will make his 2026 season debut today.
items.why: Official active; season debut after knee issue.
items.implication: Immediate TE1 lock; high opportunity in debut.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected as featured TE.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs. Chiefs with knee injury; coach Hafley later said early eval 'does not sound very optimistic' for significant injury.
items.why: Knee injury mid-game then ruled out; postgame coach pessimism.
items.implication: Major loss for MIA backfield; monitor severity for ROS.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RB opportunity elevated if multi-week.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active today vs. the Cowboys after pregame workout on hamstring; Rapoport notes likely limited usage.
items.why: Pregame workout looked good; official active listing.
items.implication: Startable but risky/snap-count potential; reverse prior OUT projections and Bateman/Andrews bumps.
items.opportunity: Limited routes/targets possible; monitor early usage.

items.text: Berry on Flowers active: Risky but if active for Baltimore he's active for me; start over Bateman.

Jets WR Adonai Mitchell expected inactive (finger); Levitan details WR depth: Garrett Wilson, Isaiah Williams, Jamaal Pritchett, Sterling Shepard, Malik McLain; TE Kenyon Sadiq expected more slot/wide.
items.why: Finger injury; confirmed expected inactive per Fowler source.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1; secondary WRs and Sadiq see elevated routes/targets.
items.opportunity: Increased target share for Wilson and slot options.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder, Q) expected to play and is active vs Chargers; ETR/Levitan projected in but limited.
items.implication: Startable with volume risk if limited.

items.text: Levitan: Flowers (hamstring) out in projections currently (possible play, late swap Bateman/Andrews DFS); Moore in limited, Mitchell out. Projecting Warren/Evans/Bowers IN.
items.why: Team not counting on; no new info early.
items.implication: DFS late swap priority; reverse on confirmation of active.

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren expected to play (shoulder) and confirmed active; ETR/Levitan projecting IN.
items.why: Weekend reports expected; Schefter active list.
items.implication: Full RB role with Dowdle out; strong start.

items.text: Mike Evans and Jalen Coker expected to play and active; Legette out for Panthers elevating Coker.
items.why: ETR summary expected; Schefter/Rapoport actives; Legette inactive.
items.implication: Evans startable; Coker upgraded with Legette out.

items.text: ETR weekend summary: Flowers GTD (not counting on), Spears hopeful GTD; Expected: Warren/Pittman, Barkley/Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman; Q: Parkinson trending right, Bagent.
items.implication: Confidence in key actives; Flowers uncertainty resolved later to active.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams Grade 2 hamstring, 3-4 week injury per sources (with Rapoport); Bagent cleared concussion protocol, no designation for MNF.
items.implication: Bagent starts MNF; Bears pass catchers downgraded short-term.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins OUT second straight week (hamstring); decent chance return Week 4 vs DAL.
Berry loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.opportunity: High carry/volume vs weak run D.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 util 86; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Berry loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.opportunity: High aDOT targets vs soft secondary.

items.text: Berry hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble last week; JAX allows only 55 rush yds/g to RBs, 3.2 YPC.
items.implication: Sit; Henderson more positive but not full takeover.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: With Nico Collins out, Dalton Schultz 28-30% target share last week; faces IND allowing 4th-most TE yards. Loves Schultz @ IND.
items.why: Collins absence drove 28% share; matchup boost.
items.implication: TE streamer/start with Collins out again.
